verdict.rationale: Twenty documents connecting a Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 account so that emails and calendar events automatically appear on the relevant CRM records, with emails explicitly linked to matching Company and People records. This covers the core of the story: synced meetings showing up on contact records. missing for 10: explicit evidence that calendar events attach to deal/opportunity timelines (not just People/Company), calendar-specific sync detail (matching rules, filtering), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
